# Tab stops: HT, HTS, TBC, CHT, CBT. Default stops are every 8 columns.

=== HT moves to the next default stop
source: vttest menu 2 (tab stops); xterm ctlseqs HT
input: \t
cursor: 1,9

=== HT stops at the right edge
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_DECAWM_TabDoesNotWrapAround
input: \t\t\t
cursor: 1,10

=== HT does not write cells
source: vttest menu 2; xterm ctlseqs HT
input: ab\tc
cursor: 1,10
screen:
|ab......c.|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== HTS sets a stop at the cursor
source: esctest2 hts.py test_HTS_Basic
input: \e[1;3H\eH\r\t
cursor: 1,3

=== TBC 0 clears the stop at the cursor
source: esctest2 tbc.py test_TBC_0, test_TBC_Default
input: \e[1;9H\e[g\r\t
cursor: 1,10

=== TBC 3 clears every stop
source: esctest2 tbc.py test_TBC_3
size: 20x2
input: \e[3g\t
cursor: 1,20

=== TBC with no stop under the cursor does nothing
source: esctest2 tbc.py test_TBC_NoOp
input: \e[1;4H\e[g\r\t
cursor: 1,9

=== CHT moves one stop by default
source: esctest2 cht.py test_CHT_OneTabStopByDefault
size: 20x2
input: \e[I
cursor: 1,9

=== CHT moves several stops
source: esctest2 cht.py test_CHT_ExplicitParameter
size: 20x2
input: \e[2I
cursor: 1,17

=== CHT ignores the scroll region
source: esctest2 cht.py test_CHT_IgnoresScrollingRegion
size: 20x5
input: \e[2;3r\e[5;1H\e[2I
cursor: 5,17

=== CBT moves back one stop by default
source: esctest2 cbt.py test_CBT_OneTabStopByDefault
size: 20x2
input: \e[1;20H\e[Z
cursor: 1,17

=== CBT moves back several stops
source: esctest2 cbt.py test_CBT_ExplicitParameter
size: 20x2
input: \e[1;20H\e[2Z
cursor: 1,9

=== CBT stops at the left edge
source: esctest2 cbt.py test_CBT_StopsAtLeftEdge
size: 20x2
input: \e[1;20H\e[9Z
cursor: 1,1
